_comment: MainNet deployment config. Copy to ~/.ripar/mainnet.json and fill in the
mnemonic yourself — no key is ever written here or read by an agent.
assetId is MainNet USDC (31566704), NOT TestNet USDC (10458941). bootstrap
is one-shot and takes the asset id permanently: deploying with the TestNet
id would produce a registry that settles in an asset nobody holds on this
chain, with no way to correct it. The default config file is a TestNet one,
so this is a real footgun and the reason this template exists.
disputeWindowSecs is 259200 (72h), the value the contract tests name as the
MainNet figure. The TestNet configs use 300 (5 minutes) so the suite does
not have to wait; shipping 300 to MainNet would let anyone release a
worker's escrow five minutes after a verdict.

merchant.mnemonic: <25 words — fill in locally, never commit>
